name: A morning brief on your industry
audience: Founders, analysts, anyone who should be reading more than they do
summary: Search for what has happened in the areas you name, read the pieces worth reading, and write a brief with the facts and the links. Says when nothing much happened rather than padding.

steps.instruction: For each topic in the brief, search for what has been published recently, open the three most substantial results, and read them. Report what actually happened — numbers, names, dates — with the URL for each. Skip anything that is an advertisement or a rewrite of a press release with nothing added. If a topic has nothing new, say so rather than reaching.

Write the brief. Lead with the one thing most worth knowing, in a sentence. Then each topic as a short paragraph with its facts and links. Keep numbers, names and caveats exactly as reported. If a topic had nothing, say "nothing new" and move on — a brief that pads is one nobody reads twice.
